actions.action: Cut off fully yellow, brown or mostly dead leaves at the base of the stem
Trim brown edges off leaves, leaving a thin margin
Rotate the pot every week or two
Check soil and water deeply when the top 2-3 inches are dry
Make sure the decorative pot drains and isn't holding water
Feed with balanced fertilizer every 2-4 weeks in spring and summer
Move the plant to a more sheltered spot if it is very windy
Bring indoors to the brightest window before nights drop below 10°C
Repot every 2-3 years into a pot 2-4 inches wider with well-draining mix
Check leaf undersides for spider mites and scale

reason: The answer notes damaged leaves but treats them as cosmetic, and it tells the owner to keep torn green leaves rather than cut the old lower ones, so the diagnosis and fix are only partly there; nothing it suggests is harmful.
